text:
sylvie_procure: Apex reports 14 H100s inbound; customs flagged 12 for serial/manifest mismatch. need quick decision: air expedite, depot loaners, or wait sea.

matt_ops: APAC pools at 80% util. if 12 stay held we hit nightly batch SLOs. prefer minimal customer impact.

ashley_pm: prefer depot swap if possible. what's cost vs air?

juan_vendor: options:
- Sea (6-8w) no freight surcharge
- Air (2-3d) +$2.5k/unit freight + $4.2k shipment fee
- Split (8 air) halves air cost. We'll refile manifest same-day if broker fee paid ($900). We'll refund broker if error is ours.

noah_logistics: APAC depot inventory: 6 in SIN, 3 in SYD = 9 hot-spares. Depot swap can cover 8 immediately. swap handling ~$650/unit.

matt_ops: Depot swap + broker refile for remaining units sounds best. we'll throttle non-critical batch jobs 48h.

sylvie_procure: i'll get finance pre-approval up to $7k for handling. Juan please push manifest_v2 and confirm PO amendment liability.

juan_vendor: manifest_v2 uploaded to RMA-7002, broker_cc'd. Confirmed: will reimburse broker fee if manifest error was vendor-side and sign PO amendment.

rma_bot: RMA-7002 created. status: customs_hold. attachments: manifest_v2.pdf.

noah_logistics: initiating depot swap (8 units). AWB placeholder AWB-AXS-11900. ETA swap 6-8h.

ashley_pm: prepping comms playbook if SLOs drift. keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
